brief: Minimal Unfold variations preserving opening, discovery and a revealed center.

prompts.name: Essential
prompts.prompt:
Use case: reference-guided brand artwork variation, a minimal refinement of the attached UNFOLD concept for Tincta Rewards.
Preserve the reference's core visual idea: an angular folded enclosure OPENS outward to REVEAL a small separate valuable center. Keep the warm orange/vermilion/deep oxblood palette, crisp angular planes, directional energy, asymmetry and expressive open silhouette. Simplify the actual geometry considerably, not merely the size: remove secondary spikes, subdivided triangles and redundant return faces. Approximately 6–9 broad colored planes TOTAL, including the center; the reference has far too many.
The intended association is opening / discovery / a reward revealed. This is a conceptual association, not a diagram of a financial mechanism. Keep a clearly distinct small central token-like polygon in a white gap. Use a compact irregular pentagon or broad trapezoid with at most two colored faces. It must not become an Ethereum diamond, gemstone rendering, star, coin or floating cube.
Render one complete isolated artwork on a square pure white canvas, no text, no labels, no border, no circle, no layout or extra variations. Keep the whole artwork inside a central circle occupying 76% of the canvas so no tips are cropped in an avatar. Crisp vector-like edges. Flat solid colors: orange #FF6600, vermilion #FF3300, red #FF0000, oxblood #330000. Color changes describe folds, with deliberate white separation around the center. No gradients, glow, soft shadows, texture, metallic material, photographic paper, watermarks, generic crypto symbols, bows, literal gift box, award ribbon or trophy. The result should be sophisticated, memorable, restrained and visibly related to the supplied artwork.
VARIATION A — ESSENTIAL UNFOLD.
Closest to the reference, but reduce it to a clean sculptural construction: ONE taller folded wing on the right, ONE shorter folded wing on the left, and ONE broad low supporting fold that sweeps across the base. Each wing has only two large faces; the low support has two. The central token is small and simple with two faces maximum. Remove all little corner shards, extra floor facets and narrow triangles from the reference. The left and right wings peel away from the center, like an opening wrapper, while the bottom fold holds the composition together. Modest asymmetry, tall/open upper silhouette, generous negative space. Avoid pointed bird / fox face associations: the two wings have unequal heights and directions. About eight faces total. This is the faithful reduction.

VARIATION B — COMPACT CRADLE.
Make a shorter, broader, more consolidated sibling of Unfold, with a confident compact silhouette for a profile picture. Two substantial folded arms arise from one visually continuous broad lower cradle, turning outward and slightly backward to expose a clear central opening. Their upper tips are shorter than in the reference, with one side higher. Use wide planes and at most one dark return per arm; do not scatter detached shards or make a triangular crown. A small orange/red irregular pentagonal token is suspended in the upper-middle white gap, with white space separating it from all surrounding folds. The underlying gesture is unmistakably an enclosure opening to reveal its contents. The outer shape should feel like one purposeful folded structure, not two hands, a bowl icon, a shield or a letter U. About six or seven large faces total. Preserve enough dimensional folding to remain expressive.

VARIATION C — OPEN UNFOLD.
The airiest reduction: two broad folded planes peel back in opposing diagonal directions around a small central revealed token. One long angular plane sweeps upward-left then turns back; the other begins below the center and opens upward-right, with a broad low connecting base implied through overlap. Keep each plane to two or three broad faces, not a fan of triangles. The white center opening is wider than the reference and visually flows out through the top, with the small orange/red token distinctly separate at its heart. Shape should still read as unfolding / revealing, not disconnected ribbons, lightning bolts, letter V or a butterfly. Strong controlled asymmetry, compact overall proportions, about six faces total including the two-faced center. A little more motion and breathing room than the faithful reference reduction, but equally recognizable as the same family.
